title: Refresh learning_tracker/dart_test.yaml's stale tag registry

evidence.quote: # Prevents "unknown tag" warnings when running flutter test --tags.

why: Comparing every tag declared in dart_test.yaml against every tag actually used via `@Tags([...])`/`tags: [...]` across learning_tracker/test/ (`comm -23` on the two sorted sets) shows 295 of 400 used tags are undeclared — including entire epics that clearly exist and have Makefile targets (epic_18, epic_20, epic_24, epic_28) plus dozens of story tags (story_15_2/4/7/9/11/13/15/16/17, story_18_*, story_25_2/9/22, story_26_23/31, story_27_5/14, story_i3/i4, and ~200 ad-hoc descriptive tags like `widget`, `unit`, `a11y`, `rtl`). The file's stated one job — suppressing 'unknown tag' warnings — now fails for most of the suite, defeating its purpose and adding warning noise that makes genuine problems easy to miss in CI logs.
recommendation: Regenerate the tags: block from a script that scans test/ for all @Tags()/tags: usages, or drop the file if package:test's current version no longer warns on undeclared tags.
acceptance_criteria: `comm -23` between tags used in test/ and tags declared in dart_test.yaml is empty.
